findings.title: Mutable Role and Fda3911Report Filament resources lack Eloquent policies
findings.summary: RoleResource and Fda3911ReportResource are create/edit surfaces gated mainly by canAccess(), with no matching Laravel policies. User/ExceptionCase/EpcisDocument now have policies after remediation; these mutable peers do not. Filament non-strict authorization allows abilities when no policy method exists.
findings.why_it_matters: Role editing and FDA 3911 reporting are privileged; missing policies weaken Gate/Filament authorization consistency and make new actions easier to ship without authorize checks.
findings.recommendation: Add RolePolicy and Fda3911ReportPolicy mirroring existing JobRoleAccess/canAccess gates; wire Filament can* / authorize() on mutate actions.
findings.verification_notes: Compared App Filament resources to app/Policies after prior User/EpcisDocument/ExceptionCase remediation.

findings.title: ExportTenantComplianceArchive has neither $tries nor $timeout
findings.summary: Long-running tenant compliance archive job (large CSV/ZIP generation) implements ShouldQueue with no $tries and no $timeout, so a hung export can occupy a worker indefinitely and retry posture is undefined.
findings.why_it_matters: Compliance exports can process large activity/EPCIS inventories; unbounded worker occupancy and unclear retries risk queue starvation and duplicate archives.
findings.recommendation: Set $timeout aligned under DB/redis retry_after (e.g. 3600) and $tries (e.g. 1–3) consistent with ImportFdaDatasetJob / ProcessTrackTraceExportJob.
findings.verification_notes: Job source inspected; no tries/timeout properties present.

findings.title: WMS receive-confirm loads all confirmed scan lines via unbounded get()
findings.summary: NotifyWmsReceiveConfirm::confirmedScans() loads every confirmed ReceivingScanLine with epc via ->get() before chunking HTTP POSTs. Large ASN/scan-first sessions spike memory on the queue worker.
findings.why_it_matters: Hot post-complete receiving path; large sessions can OOM or slow WMS confirmation and delay custody notifications.
findings.recommendation: Stream/chunk URI extraction with chunkById or cursor before building POST chunks; avoid materializing the full session line set.

findings.title: Additional App Filament models still lack policies (mostly read-only)
findings.summary: EpcisJob, Verification, SerializationLot, SsccLabel, ActivityLog, and FdaProduct App resources have no matching policies. Most disable writes via canCreate/canEdit false, but Filament still falls through the no-policy allow path for any ability not overridden.
findings.why_it_matters: Defense-in-depth gap relative to resources that now have policies; new mutating actions can ship without Gate coverage.

evidence.detail: Policy set does not include these models

findings.recommendation: Add thin viewAny/view policies mirroring canAccess; keep create/update/delete false where resources are read-only.
findings.verification_notes: Resource vs Policies directory comparison after prior remediation.

findings.title: ProvisionTenantScoutIndexes has neither $tries nor $timeout
findings.summary: Queued Meilisearch index-settings sync shells out via Artisan with no $tries/$timeout.
findings.why_it_matters: Index sync can run long; worker kill/retry posture is unset and can leave tenants with partial Scout provisioning.
findings.recommendation: Add $tries and $timeout appropriate for Meilisearch sync duration; fail closed on non-zero Artisan exit (already throws).

findings.title: Scan-first TI gate loads all confirmed receiving lines unbounded
findings.summary: CompleteReceivingSession::assertScanFirstTiWhenRequired() pulls every confirmed ReceivingScanLine with epc via ->get() on the complete path.
findings.why_it_matters: Large scan-first sessions pay a full-line materialization cost on every complete attempt when TI is required.
findings.recommendation: Chunk/cursor TI checks or query only epc_ids needing TI verification without hydrating all lines.

findings.title: Accept-remaining confirms load all expected parents/children unbounded
findings.summary: ConfirmRemainingExpectedReceivingLines loads all expected parent and child ReceivingScanLine rows (with epc) via ->get() with no chunk/cursor.
findings.why_it_matters: Operator accept-remaining on multi-tote ASN sessions can materialize large expected sets in one request.
findings.recommendation: Process expected lines in chunkById batches inside the existing confirmation loop.
findings.verification_notes: Action source sampled during re-pass hunt.

findings.title: OutboundConnection mass-assigns is_system and system_key
findings.summary: Privileged flags is_system and system_key remain on OutboundConnection $fillable. Conformance transitions are guarded in saving(), and deletes block system templates, but fill()/create() can still set is_system/system_key if those keys reach mass assignment.
findings.why_it_matters: System outbound templates are privileged integration configuration; mass-assignable flags are a defense-in-depth gap similar to the prior account-security fillable finding.
findings.recommendation: Remove is_system/system_key from fillable; set only via dedicated seeders/forceFill paths for system templates.
findings.verification_notes: Model fillable inspected; no request-path exploit proven (confidence medium).

findings.title: Mutable Admin Filament resources lack Eloquent policies
findings.summary: Admin panel create/edit surfaces (Admins, Announcements, Tenants, MailTemplates, FDA registry CRUD) gate access via Permissions::* canAccess/canViewAny only. App panel remediations added Eloquent policies for Role/Fda3911/etc.; Admin mutable peers still have no Admin-typed policies. Filament non-strict authorization allows abilities when no policy method exists.
findings.why_it_matters: Platform admin CRUD is highly privileged (tenant lifecycle, admin accounts, announcements). Missing policies weaken Gate/Filament consistency and make new mutate actions easy to ship without authorize().

evidence.detail: Admin model; canAccess via Permissions::AdminsManage; no AdminPolicy

findings.recommendation: Add Admin-guard policies (AdminPolicy, AnnouncementPolicy, TenantPolicy, …) mirroring Permissions::* gates; type-hint App\Models\Admin; wire Filament can* to policies.
findings.verification_notes: App panel 29/29 resources mapped to policies after F-0101/0104; Admin mutable resources have no matching *Policy.php; tests/Feature/Policies has no Admin policy coverage.

findings.title: Read-mostly Admin Filament resources lack Eloquent policies
findings.summary: Admin DemoRequest, CustomerOnboarding, FdaImportRun, match-review, and WDD list resources disable writes via canCreate/canEdit false but still have no Eloquent policies, so Filament falls through the no-policy allow path for any ability not overridden.
findings.why_it_matters: Read paths still expose PII/ops data; missing policies make accidental enablement of create/edit unsafe by default.
findings.recommendation: Add thin viewAny/view policies for Admin read resources; keep create/update/delete false.
findings.verification_notes: Same AUD-FIL-001 pattern as F-0104 for App panel; Admin still open.

findings.title: Five ShouldQueue jobs declare neither $tries nor $timeout
findings.summary: After remediating ExportTenantComplianceArchive / ProvisionTenantScoutIndexes / FanOutAnnouncementToTenant, several queued jobs still omit both $tries and $timeout: SeedSystemOutboundTemplates, SeedTenantRoles, RetireAnnouncementOnTenant, PromoteEpcisExceptionToCaseJob, EnsureTenantStorageDirectoriesJob.
findings.why_it_matters: Tenant provision and announcement retire paths can hang a worker indefinitely; undefined retry posture risks duplicate seed work or stuck exception promotion.

evidence.detail: Contrast: remidiated peer has tries=3 timeout=300

findings.recommendation: Add $tries and $timeout aligned under queue retry_after (3900); mirror FanOutAnnouncementToTenant for announcement retire; use tries=1 for idempotent seeders if duplicates are harmful.
findings.verification_notes: Source inspected; ExportTenantComplianceArchive and ProvisionTenantScoutIndexes remain fixed with bounds.

findings.title: Operational jobs set $tries but omit $timeout
findings.summary: NotifyWmsReceiveConfirm ($tries=3), GenerateReceivingLpnLabelJob, ForwardCommissioningToL3, PrintSsccLabelJob, RunProductVerificationJob, SyncTenantAtpLicensesFromFda, and BackfillCatalogPartnerPlacesJob declare retries without a worker $timeout, so a hung HTTP/print call can occupy the worker until the connection layer fails.
findings.why_it_matters: WMS confirm, VRS, L3 forward, and label print are latency-bound external I/O; without timeout, retries alone do not bound worker occupancy.

evidence.detail: database/redis retry_after default 3900 — timeouts should stay below

findings.recommendation: Add $timeout per job class consistent with HTTP client timeouts and under retry_after; keep existing $tries.
findings.verification_notes: Confirmed property presence via source grep; ProcessEpcisDocumentJob / TransmitEpcisJob already set both.

findings.title: Match-ASN scan-first propagate loads unbounded sessions and confirmed lines
findings.summary: PropagateScanFirstConfirmsToAsnSession loads every scan-first ReceivingSession in open|in_progress|completed (site-filtered only, no time bound) via ->get(), then CopyConfirmedReceivingScansToSession loads all confirmed lines with epc via ->get() per source session. Scales with historical floor activity × EPC count on Match ASN.
findings.why_it_matters: Busy warehouses accumulate completed scan-first sessions; Match ASN can spike memory/latency and stall the request/worker after F-0103/0106/0107 receiving hot-paths were already chunked.

evidence.detail: scan-first sessions whereIn status → orderBy id → get()

findings.recommendation: Bound candidate sessions (recent window / still-open-first / overlapping EPCs); chunkById confirmed lines when copying; preserve parent-then-child order.
findings.verification_notes: Prior receiving remediations still use chunkById; this Match ASN path does not. Transfer twin PropagateScanFirstConfirmsToTransferReceiveSession follows the same session get() pattern.

findings.title: Domain EPCIS hard-gate hydrates full event/EPC graph via get()
findings.summary: RunDomainEpcisHardGate::handle loads all active events, then all EventEpc (with epc) and EventQuantity rows for the document via whereIn(...)->get() before ValidationPipeline. Large inbound ASN documents materialize the full graph in memory on validate/commit.
findings.why_it_matters: Ingest/validate is on the critical path for large partner files; unbounded hydration risks memory spikes even when queue jobs have timeouts.
findings.recommendation: Stream/chunk event graph into ValidationContext or validate in batches if pipeline contracts allow; otherwise document memory budget and fail closed earlier on event-count caps.
findings.verification_notes: GenerateReceivingEpcisEvents also loads all confirmed EPCs under lockForUpdate — not filed separately because single ObjectEvent authorship requires a consistent locked set (architectural necessity, not a pure unbounded list scan).
